title: Elemental reactions
changes: An elemental hit now marks a monster for 4 seconds; a hit of another element on the mark sets off a reaction.
Cold + Electric: Fracture. Fire + Poison: Toxic Blast. Fire + Cold: Steam. Electric + Poison: Corrosion. Faith + Fire: Purification.
Reactions work in full on a mark another hero left, at 30% on your own (your creatures count as you). Monsters only, never against heroes.
The Group panel (P) lists the reactions.
